messages:
maya l: quick follow-up from the pager-drift postmortem. want owners + short ETAs so we don't keep seeing the same churn.
maya l: tl;dr: recurring flaps from redis shard rebalances plus tight thresholds caused noisy repeats. proposed bite-sized actions below, pls claim.
  1) replace ephemeral `instance` in dedupe key with stable shard+metric fingerprint
  2) escalate sustain windows for shard-level alerts and add repage backoff
  3) soften paging policy for transient spikes (route to ops-queue first)
  4) run two-week noise-run after changes and publish short report
please volunteer owner + ETA (date or "tomorrow EOD"). :spiral_calendar:
jorge a: i'll take 1. plan: change dedupe template to `{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $labels.metric }}` and add unit test that replays a shard move. ETA: Thu EOD (2024-04-18).
priya k: i'll own 2. propose `for: 90s` -> `for: 180s` for high-cardinality alerts and add annotation `repage_suppress: 15m` to avoid repeats. ETA: today (2024-04-16) afternoon.
 tom_s: i'll do 3 and 4. routing: only page S0 if sustained >120s or error_rate>1% for 60s, otherwise post to #ops-queue. will schedule the 14-day monitor job to start after deploy. ETA: routing PR by Mon AM (2024-04-20), monitor report at +48h and +14d.
infra-bot: Silence set by tom_s for #pager-duty until 2024-04-20T08:00Z. Incident REDIS-2024-04-16 attached.
jorge a: quick config snippet for 1:
```yaml
labels:
  dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $labels.alert_name }}"
```
priya k: sustain/backoff example:
```yaml
for: 180s
annotations:
  repage_suppress: 15m
```
priya k: i'll run a staging replay `tools/alert_replay --fixture shard-rebalance.json` to validate before flip.
maya l: can each owner drop a one-liner ETA for me to add to the PM tracker? want to close this out in 2 weeks.
jorge a: ETA Thu EOD (2024-04-18) - PR + tests.
priya k: ETA 2024-04-16 EOD - config + staging validation.
 tom_s: ETA 2024-04-20 AM - routing PR; monitor scheduled to run after deploy.
maya l: i'll update the postmortem with owners/timelines and set a 15m check-in next Wed to confirm closure. if anything blocks, reopen this thread. thanks :thumbsup:
jorge a: no blockers from dedupe side.
priya k: none here.
 tom_s: ops ready for staging replay. will post monitor links in thread.
maya l: closing loop for now, will paste tracker link when updated.
